environment.description: Flask application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) running directly via gunicorn with no container isolation. The application runs as ec2-user with standard Linux capabilities. No WAF or reverse proxy in front. Security group allows inbound 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. IAM instance role has s3:* and ssm:GetParameter permissions. ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable is set but the /debug/render endpoint is accessible without authentication.
